title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: GAR — so rightly imputed; we sin in Adam by corruption and by his act
pass_a_gloss: On his pairing: the vice that flows down from Adam into us already grounds 'sinning in him,' and he adds the same for Adam's earlier deed itself—so both the inherited spoil and the paradise act are made to underwrite the phrase.
pass_b_english: And so as we are rightly said to sin in Adam because of the corruption descending into us from Adam: so also we shall be said truly to sin in him, because of the act which Adam performed before.
source_text: Itaque ut recte dicimur peccare in Adamo propter corruptionem in nobis ab Adamo descendentem: Ita & vere peccare dicemur in eo, propter actionem quam Adamus praecessit.

lemmas.gloss: the act which Adam performed before

choices.choice: Sin in Adam by descending corruption and by his prior act
